text: Based on the provided evidence, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection in healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. Regarding suitability, the vaccine is generally well tolerated; however, it is not suitable for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any component of the vaccine, who should avoid it. The text does not provide information on efficacy or suitability for age groups outside the 18-55 range or for individuals with other health conditions.
